The monomials in the generators $\{t_{ij}^{(r)}\mid 1\leqslant i,j\leqslant N,r\geqslant 1\}$ taken in any fixed linear order form a basis of $\mathrm{Y}(\mathfrak{gl}_{N})$ .

Define the loop filtration on $\mathrm{Y}(\mathfrak{gl}_{N})$ by setting

(2.4)

$\displaystyle\deg t_{ij}^{(r)}=r-1$

for every $r\geqslant 1$ . Let $\mathcal{F}_{s}\mathrm{Y}(\mathfrak{gl}_{N})$ be the subspace of $\mathrm{Y}(\mathfrak{gl}_{N})$ spanned by elements of degree $\leqslant s$ ,

$\mathcal{F}_{0}\mathrm{Y}(\mathfrak{gl}_{N})\subset\mathcal{F}_{1}\mathrm{Y}(\mathfrak{gl}_{N})\subset\mathcal{F}_{2}\mathrm{Y}(\mathfrak{gl}_{N})\subset\cdots,\qquad\mathrm{Y}(\mathfrak{gl}_{N})=\bigcup_{s\geqslant 1}\mathcal{F}_{s}\mathrm{Y}(\mathfrak{gl}_{N}).$

Denote by $\mathrm{gr}\mathrm{Y}(\mathfrak{gl}_{N})$ the associated graded algebra. We write $\bar{t}_{ij}^{(r)}$ for the image of $t_{ij}^{(r)}$ in $\mathrm{gr}\mathrm{Y}(\mathfrak{gl}_{N})$ .

Let $\mathfrak{gl}_{N}[z]$ denote the current algebra $\mathfrak{gl}_{N}\otimes\mathbb{C}[z]$ with the standard basis

$\{e_{ij}z^{r}\penalty\ |\penalty\ 1\leqslant i,j\leqslant N,\ r\geqslant 0\}.$

Let $\mathrm{U}(\mathfrak{gl}_{N}[z])$ be the universal enveloping algebra of $\mathfrak{gl}_{N}[z]$ . Then the map

$\mathrm{U}(\mathfrak{gl}_{N}[z])\to\mathrm{gr}\mathrm{Y}(\mathfrak{gl}_{N}),\qquad e_{ij}\otimes z^{r}\mapsto\bar{t}_{ij}^{(r+1)},$

induces a Hopf algebra isomorphism.

Let $\mathfrak{S}_{N}$ be the symmetric group on the letters $\{1,2,\dots,N\}$ . Define the quantum determinant of $T(u)$ by

(2.5)

${\mathrm{qdet}}T(u)=\sum_{\sigma\in\mathfrak{S}_{N}}(-1)^{\sigma}t_{\sigma(1),1}(u)t_{\sigma(2),2}(u-1)\cdots t_{\sigma(N),N}(u-N+1).$

The coefficients of ${\mathrm{qdet}}T(u)$ are algebraically independent generators of the center of $\mathrm{Y}(\mathfrak{gl}_{N})$ ; see [Mol07, Thm. 1.7.5]. The quantum determinant is group-like under the coproduct [Mol07, Cor. 1.6.10]:

(2.6)

$\Delta({\mathrm{qdet}}T(u))={\mathrm{qdet}}T(u)\otimes{\mathrm{qdet}}T(u).$

2.2. Twisted Yangians

We shall consider twisted Yangians of type AI and AII in some $N\times N$ matrix forms. We denote a classical Lie algebra by

(2.7)

$\displaystyle\mathfrak{g}_{N}=\begin{cases}\mathfrak{o}_{N},&\text{ in type AI},\\
\mathfrak{sp}_{N},&\text{ in type AII},\end{cases}$

where in the latter case $N$ is assumed to be even. Throughout the article, whenever the signs $\pm$ or $\mp$ show up, the top one corresponds to type AI while the bottom one corresponds to AII. To describe the two cases in a uniform way, we introduce the following convention.

In type AI, we set

(2.8)

$i^{\prime}=i\quad\text{ and }\quad\theta_{i}=1,\quad\forall 1\leqslant i\leqslant N.$

In type AII, we set

(2.9)

$i^{\prime}=\begin{cases}i-1,&\text{ if }i=2k,\\
i+1,&\text{ if }i=2k-1,\end{cases}\qquad\qquad\theta_{i}=(-1)^{i}.$

In both cases, we take

(2.10)

$G=(\delta_{ij^{\prime}}\theta_{i})_{1\leqslant i,j\leqslant N}.$

Note that $G=\mathbf{I}_{N}$ is the identity matrix in type AI.

Define the generating series, for $1\leqslant i,j\leqslant N$ ,

(2.11)

$s_{ij}(u)=\delta_{ij}+s_{ij}^{(1)}u^{-1}+s_{ij}^{(2)}u^{-2}+\cdots.$

paper.title: Shifted twisted Yangians and finite $W$-algebras of classical type
paper.abstract: We introduce parabolic presentations of twisted Yangians of types AI and AII, interpolating between the R-matrix presentation and the Drinfeld presentation. Then we formulate and provide parabolic presentations for the shifted twisted Yangians. We define quotient algebras known as truncated shifted twisted Yangians and equip them with baby comultiplications, generalizing the work of Brundan and Kleshchev. PBW bases for all (truncated) shifted twisted Yangians of type AI and AII are established along the way. Applying the theory of universal equivariant quantizations of conic symplectic singularities we show that the truncated twisted shifted Yangian is isomorphic to the finite $W$-algebra which quantizes a suitable Slodowy slice. This provides a presentation of the finite $W$-algebra associated with every even nilpotent element in type {\sf B} and {\sf C}, as well as every nilpotent element with two Jordan blocks in type {\sf D}. Finally we make a conjecture which would supply presentations in the remaining even cases in type {\sf D}.
